device.description: 14-bit 2-channel voltage-output DAC with 2.5-V reference, SPI or I2C interface
device.note: dac60502.pdf (SBAS793A) p.3 pinout, p.4 recommended operating conditions, p.21-22 register structure and POR, p.23 SPI mode (Table 1), p.24-28 I2C (Tables 3-7), p.29-33 register map

registers.name: DEVID
registers.note: p.29: bit diagram 0, RESOLUTION, 0010 0001 0101 (the header prints 0214h; the bit diagram and the 11-0 field reset 0215h are used)

registers.name: TRIGGER
registers.note: p.31: write-only, self-resetting; handled by the TRIGGER commands

registers.name: BRDCAST
registers.note: p.32: written by the BRDCAST commands; reset 8000h when RSTSEL = 1

registers.name: DAC_A
registers.note: p.33: MSB aligned; reset 0000h (RSTSEL = AGND) or 8000h (RSTSEL = VDD)

registers.name: DAC_A_ACT
registers.note: DAC active register (internal, section 8.3.1.2): loaded from DAC_A at once (asynchronous mode) or by the TRIGGER LDAC bit (synchronous mode)

registers.name: DAC_B_ACT
registers.note: DAC active register (internal, section 8.3.1.2): loaded from DAC_B at once (asynchronous mode) or by the TRIGGER LDAC bit (synchronous mode)

commands.name: BRDCAST
commands.note: p.32 Table 15: a BRDCAST write loads the active registers of the channels whose DAC-x-BRDCAST-EN bit is set

commands.name: Command byte (NOOP/DEVID/SYNC/CONFIG)
commands.note: p.27-28: Table 5 command byte selects the register; MSDB and LSDB follow (Table 6); read: command byte, repeated start, MSDB, LSDB (Table 7); a read without a command byte returns the last register addressed

commands.name: Command byte (TRIGGER)
commands.note: TRIGGER (5h) written through the pointer; SOFT-RESET and LDAC run as protocol.triggers

commands.name: Command byte (DAC-A DATA)
commands.note: asynchronous mode (SYNC.DAC_A_SYNC_EN = 0): each register written through the pointer updates the active register at once

commands.name: Command byte (DAC-A DATA) (synchronous)
commands.note: synchronous mode: the active register updates on the TRIGGER LDAC bit

commands.name: Command byte (DAC-B DATA)
commands.note: asynchronous mode (SYNC.DAC_B_SYNC_EN = 0): each register written through the pointer updates the active register at once

commands.name: Command byte (DAC-B DATA) (synchronous)
commands.note: synchronous mode: the active register updates on the TRIGGER LDAC bit

pages: p.3 (pinout), p.4 (ROC), p.21-22 (register structure, POR, soft reset), p.23 (SPI frame), p.24-28 (I2C, address, command and read sequence), p.29-33 (registers)
notModeled: analog outputs, internal reference, REF-DIV, gains, power-down and reference alarm (stored only)

SPI mode (SPI2C = 0): a write-only 3-wire SYNC/SCLK/SDIN interface with 24-bit frames (R/W + address byte + 16 data bits, latched at SYNC rising, short frames discarded); the model is the I2C mode (SPI2C = 1), which has read-back
TRIGGER.LDAC and SOFT-RESET self-clear in the chip; the model leaves the written value in TRIGGER (each later TRIGGER write with LDAC = 1 updates again)
BRDCAST is write-only (Table 15, W): a command byte 06h alone (to read it) is not decoded, because an 8-bit read pointer would preempt the 24-bit BRDCAST write; BRDCAST stays write-only
command bytes with B23-B20 non-zero are ignored; I2C fast-mode plus; the 250-us POR delay
variants: dac60502.pdf covers DAC80502 (16-bit), DAC70502 (14-bit) and DAC60502 (12-bit); own spec files, identical except bits and DEVID
